findings.finding_id: plugin/skills/faff/bin/lib/pr-open.ts::level for the mint is read from the live run ledger
findings.title: Level for the mint is read from the live run ledger
findings.action: Note why a live read is acceptable here.
findings.disposition_rationale: The spec reads the level from the run ledger; the reader checks it against the anchored level at consume time, and the mint is self-attestation by design (see the trust note in evidence-documents.md).

findings.finding_id: plugin/skills/faff/bin/lib/pr-open.ts::a failed anchor step leaves the run-dir copy and stamp stranded
findings.title: A failed anchor step leaves the run-dir copy and stamp stranded
findings.action: Clear the run-dir copy on an anchor refusal.
findings.disposition_rationale: The next pr open clears both copies and re-mints, and the reader takes the last stamp; the file is only read from slice 2.
